values.meaning: duration of the damage reduction buff before it ends automatically
delay before the ability can be recast

mechanics.claim: Primal Howl can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
mechanics.quote: ''Primal Howl'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts after the recast/end of the effect, not on initial cast.
Starting the R channel while Primal Howl is active triggers the recast without ending the damage reduction buff early.
mechanics.quote: Starting ''{{ais|Infinite Duress|Warwick}}'' channel while ''Primal Howl'' is active will initiate the recast without ending the damage reduction buff prematurely.

mechanics.claim: The recast resets Warwick's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Primal Howl's recast {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Warwick's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: The recast has a lockout animation that cancels a basic attack and prevents attacking or casting during it.
mechanics.quote: The recast's howling animation has a {{fd|0.25}}-second {{tip|lockout}} time.

mechanics.claim: The initial cast and manual recast each count as ability activations for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}

mechanics.claim: If not manually recast, the secondary effect triggers without counting as an ability activation.
mechanics.quote: If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.

mechanics.claim: The basic attack reset from the recast does not count as one for Hail of Blades.
mechanics.quote: The basic attack reset is not considered one for {{ri|Hail of Blades}}.
